turns.input: *He looks at Orla Fen, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.narration:
Orla Fen stands with her waterproofed apron draped over her forearms, her short grey hair catching the daylight. Her hands are laced with red, permanently raised from years in water and lye. She meets Nicco's gaze with the flat patience of someone who has been looked at many times before.

"You're the new one at the tower," she says, not quite a question. "I've seen the door open again. Lights at hours that don't match any household I know." She does not introduce herself. She does not ask his name. She merely stands there, waiting to see what use he might be, or what trouble he might bring to her corner of the square.

[CURRENT AUTHORITATIVE SCENE]
Location: Heartstone Square. Heartstone's massive main entrance opens directly onto this public square, outside the tower's structure. The square is reasonably broad but is not a major civic square. Moderate daytime foot traffic is quieter than at Main Market Square. Low residential buildings predominate, with few nearby shops and no major commercial concentration. Night safety is mediocre. The low-end, disreputable tavern The Coined Lie faces or directly adjoins the square. The White Basin is a laundry near Heartstone, without an established position directly on the square.
